items.title: SLB (SLB) Started A Major 3D Seismic Survey Off Brazil
items.summary: SLB (NYSE:SLB) and Shearwater GeoServices launched a large 3D seismic survey off Brazil's Equatorial Margin to support hydrocarbon exploration. The project focuses on acquiring advanced geophysical data in an underexplored offshore zone that has attracted growing industry interest. Shearwater is supplying high-capacity seismic vessels, while SLB contributes subsurface imaging and processing to refine future exploration and licensing decisions.
